$comment: The canonical city state registry (workbook section 20, P2-F; see docs/city/OWNER_CONTINUOUS_CONSTRUCTION_WORKBOOK.md). Every capability (plot) has EXACTLY ONE state here. FLAT means 'no defect on this plot was measured by the four instruments this programme runs' -- it is NOT a certification that the plot is well designed, and the instruments do not yet cover everything section 33 asks for. A plot implicated by a MEASURED defect may not be recorded FLAT: scripts/city-flatness-validator.cjs fails if it is, so the registry cannot be made true by editing it.
unit_of_state: one capability manifest. The composition root is not a plot: it is the platform's wiring, classified in config/capability-modules.json.
precedence: when more than one state applies, the MOST BLOCKING one is recorded: UNSAFE_GAP > MIGRATION_IN_PROGRESS > PARTIALLY_DEGRADED > TEMPORARILY_BRIDGED > FLAT. A plot whose state is more blocking than a bridge it also carries still lists that bridge under `bridges`, so no declaration is lost by the precedence rule.
seal_note: The five states are all that may appear here; the SEAL may contain only FLAT, and section 20 also forbids an undeclared PARTIALLY_DEGRADED and an expired TEMPORARILY_BRIDGED. `node scripts/city-flatness-validator.cjs --seal` fails while any plot is seal-blocking, which is the honest state of a programme mid-migration.
